s: Din perure happat, ubo v' seipim: kol mi sheeno meshayyer pat al shulchano — en roeh siman beraka leolam, shenneemar "en sarid leoklo, al ken lo yachil tubo", abal bibraka mahu omer? "Akol vehoter":
Venakon shello lehasir hammappa vehallechem ad achar birkat hammazon, kede sheyyehe nikkar shemmebarek Hashem al chasdo vetubo haggadol, shehekin mazon lekol beriyyotayv:

Im lo nishar lo lechem al hashshulchan — lo yabi pat shelema veyittenenna al hashshulchan, mippene shennireh keorek shulchan laaboda zara, kemo sheamar hakkatub: "haorekim laggad shulchan vego'". Abal im hayeta shelema munnachat kebar al hashshulchan, kemo shebbeshabbat botzeim al lechem mishneh — tob shello lahasirah ad achar birkat hammazon:

Bime chakme hattalmud shehayu mesalleqim et hashshulchanot haqqetannot shellipne kol echad veechad qodem mayim acharonim, vehayu notelim mayim acharonim bimqom hashshulchanot — hayu tzerikim lekabbed qarqa habbayit bimqom hashshulchanot qodem hannetila, shello yishshaaru sham perure pat veyimmaasu beme hannetila. Veap al pi shemmuttar leabbed perurim sheen bahem kezayit — chosheshim shemma yihyeh hashshammash am haaretz, shemmuttar lehishtammesh beshammash am haaretz, veyanniach al hashshulchan gam perurim sheyyesh bahem kezayit keshemmesir hallechem meal hashshulchan, veachar kak yippelu mimmennu keshemmesalleqin otan mishsham veyimmaasu beme hannetila, lekak yekabbed techilla. Abal anu sheen anu mesalleqin hashshulchan, veanu notelim hayyadayim bemaqom sheen sham perurim — en tzarik lekabbed techilla:

Ap al pi shemmuttar leabbed perurim sheen bahem kezayit bayyadayim — lo yizreqem bimqom derisat ragle bene adam, mippene sheqqasheh laaniyyut kesheddoresim al perure lechem, velo hittiru ella leabbedam, kegon lehashlikam lammayim vekayyotze bazeh:

Nohagim lekassot hassakkin bishat birkat hammazon, ki hashshulchan domeh lemizbeach, ubammizbeach neemar: "lo tanip alehem barzel", lepi shehabbarzel meqatztzer yamayv shel adam vehammizbeach maarik yeme haadam, veeno bedin sheyyunap hamqatztzer al hammaarik, vegam hashshulchan maarik yamayv shel adam umekapper avonotayv behaknasat orechim, sheggadol kochah shel legima shemmashra shekina. Venahagu bimqomot harbeh shello lekassoto beshabbat veyom tob, ki bechol mekassin oto mippene shehu kocho shel esav, ubeshabbat veyom tob en satan upega ra. Uminhagan shel yisrael tora hi:
